props.heading: Best trips from Panama City on a budget
props.subheading: Real flight, hotel, and activity costs for the destinations that actually fit what you have to spend — flying out of PTY.

props.text: Panama City's Tocumen airport is built as Copa Airlines' "Hub of the Americas" — which is exactly why Medellín gets near-daily service while Grand Cayman gets just two flights a week. Flying out of PTY, a trip to Medellín can start around $1,070 for flight, hotel, and activities together — not just the flight, pulled from our own cost data, not guesses.

features.title: Cancún — nonstop, ~2h49m
features.text: Copa Airlines is the only nonstop carrier, about 40 flights a week (5–6 a day).

features.title: Medellín — nonstop, ~1h21m–1h25m
features.text: Copa Airlines flies it, densely — 61 flights a week, 7–9 a day, one of Copa's busiest regional routes.

features.title: Grand Cayman — nonstop, but only 2 flights/week
features.text: Cayman Airways is the only carrier serving this route, and the schedule is genuinely thin — book well ahead of your dates.

props.text: Tocumen was purpose-built as Copa's 24/7 connecting hub for fast Caribbean and South America travel, and the frequency gap between these three routes reflects that directly: Medellín sits inside Copa's dense core network and gets near-hourly-feeling service, while Grand Cayman sits outside it and relies solely on twice-weekly Cayman Airways flights. Medellín also has a real, checkable cost advantage — average daily travel costs there run well below Panama City, making it a genuine budget weekend option. Panamanians travel visa-free to Mexico, Colombia, and the Dominican Republic-adjacent Caribbean, which removes a common trip-planning friction point across all three.

items.question: Are these real-time prices?
items.answer: They're estimates based on our own curated cost data for this route and season, not a live quote — the real price on the partner site may be a bit higher or lower depending on exact dates.

items.question: Why are there so few flights to Grand Cayman compared to Medellín?
items.answer: Medellín rides Copa's own dense hub schedule (up to 9 flights a day), while Grand Cayman relies solely on Cayman Airways' twice-weekly service since it falls outside Copa's core network — book Cayman trips well ahead of your dates.

items.question: Is Medellín a realistic weekend trip from Panama City?
items.answer: Yes — it's an 80-minute nonstop flight with near-daily frequency, and day-to-day costs in Medellín run well below Panama City, making it a genuine budget weekend option.
